title: Anatomy of a data table
back: Title → headings and units → largest and smallest → rows vs columns → footnote. One minute, before the items.

title: Visual first, then the items
back: Title → headings, units → extremes → trend → skim prose → answer with figures.

title: Percentage points
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="How to describe a change between percentages" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="70" width="80" height="50" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="80.0" y="100.6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">48%</text><path d="M125,95 L195,95 M186.2,99.8 L195,95 L186.2,90.2" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="200" y="70" width="80" height="50" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="240.0" y="100.6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">60%</text><text x="160" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">by 12 percentage points — not 'by 12'</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">How to describe a change between percentages</text></svg>
back: Say 'from 48% to 60%' or 'by 12 percentage points'. 'By 12' or 'by 60%' loses the mark.

title: Quote the figure
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="An answer without the number reads as a guess" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="60" y="60" width="200" height="80" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="160" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Class 12, at 4.6 hours,</text><text x="160" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">was the highest</text><circle cx="260" cy="60" r="14" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">An answer without the number reads as a guess</text></svg>
back: Name the category or year and give the value with its unit — hours, per cent, people — exactly as the chart has it.

title: Link, not cause
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="A survey shows correlation, not proof" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><circle cx="100" cy="95" r="40" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><circle cx="220" cy="95" r="40" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><path d="M140,95 H180" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="8 6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="100" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">screens</text><text x="220" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">less sleep</text><text x="160" y="170" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">the data suggests…</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">A survey shows correlation, not proof</text></svg>
back: Infer only what the numbers support: 'students who use screens late sleep less in this sample' — not 'screens cause poor sleep' or 'students are lazy'.
